name: PDC Bounced Recovery
query: SELECT name AS "PDC:Link/PDC:160", customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:180", cheque_no AS "Cheque No:Data:130", reference_date AS "Cheque Date:Date:120", amount AS "Amount:Currency:120", cleared_amount AS "Cleared:Currency:120", (amount - IFNULL(cleared_amount, 0)) AS "Recovery Amount:Currency:130", bounced_reason AS "Reason:Data:220", replacement_pdc AS "Replacement PDC:Link/PDC:160", bounce_charges_invoice AS "Bounce Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:160", pdc_status AS "Status:Data:140" FROM `tabPDC` WHERE docstatus = 1 AND pdc_status IN ('Bounced', 'Partially Bounced') ORDER BY reference_date DESC
